children: SoftBank Group plans to repay the outstanding balance of $25.9 billion taken under a bridge loan agreement for its OpenAI investments.
The Japanese technology investment company said Wednesday that it will prepay the sum on Sept. 15.
SoftBank Group had previously drawn $30.0 billion under the facility.
The company had agreed to repay the balance taken under the bridge loan by the maturity date of March 25, 2027.
